_provenance: RECORDED FROM DOCUMENTATION, NOT FROM A LIVE CALL, and that distinction is the whole reason this directory exists. Nobody may spend money to make a test pass, so every shape here was copied from fal's REST queue documentation (fal.ai/docs/model-endpoints/queue, read 2026-08-20) rather than from a response we paid for. What that buys: the provider's parsing is exercised against the shape the vendor SAYS it returns. What it does not buy: any evidence that the vendor actually returns it. The first live call through test/fal-smoke.test.js is what turns these from plausible into true, and if one of them is wrong that test is where it shows.
